descriptions.notStarted: I'm finally starting to feel more comfortable in my skin as a Pirate. #bKyrin#k is offering to help train me for this final step...
descriptions.inProgress: Kyrin wants to test the skills I've acquired throughout my training. She wants me to hunt down #r10 green mushrooms#k. Green mushrooms are apparently much more powerful than the pigs so Kyrin is warning me to keep alert. \n\n#o 1110100# #r#a21961##k
descriptions.completed: I've hunted down 10 green mushrooms. That was not an easy task, but in any case, it was a success! Kyrin, the Director of Job Advancement for Pirates, is finally acknowledging me as a real Pirate.
